title: fix(app-shell): Setup's Assigned users grants a permission set by name alone (objectui#7611, PR-3)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: no

PR-3 of the #7611 remainder (census item 5, `resolveGrantRowId` off the row), dispatched under claim amendment 6111342697. It follows objectstack-ai/objectstack#22863 (stage 6b-2-pre, on objectstack `main` as `0253192f76`), which makes `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` the grant's required, writable reference and leaves `permission_set_id` optional with no writer. #7611 stays open: PR-4 (the clone door), PR-5 (per objectstack-ai/objectstack#22865) and PR-6 (after stage 8) remain.

## What changes

- **`AssignedUsersSection` writes a grant by name alone.** `addUsers` creates `sys_user_permission_set` with `{ user_id, permission_set }`. It no longer reads the set's `sys_permission_set` row and no longer writes `permission_set_id`. `resolveGrantRowId`, the `noGrantRow` refusal and its two strings (en, zh) are gone; nothing else used them (`git grep` for both names returns only this file at the base). The module doc now says what the section reads and writes: holders by name, ADD by name, REMOVE by the grant's row id, distributing positions from the registry.
- **Revoke is unchanged.** It deletes the direct grant's own row by id.
- **Organization.** The section writes no `organization_id`, as before. Measured below: the server stamps the caller's organization on the grant.
- **Changesets.** `.changeset/7611-grant-by-name.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` minor) states the change and the server floor. The unreleased part-1 changeset `.changeset/7611-setup-catalog-registry.md` drops one sentence this PR makes false ("A new grant still carries `permission_set_id` ..."). This is a bounded in-place edit; the four conditions are listed under Acceptance notes.

## Measured on a fresh showcase

The backend is objectstack `origin/main` `72b26ed4f5` (it contains `0253192f76`), built from a detached worktree and booted with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on its own port. The console is this branch's `apps/console` under Vite, proxied to that backend. Chromium was driven by Playwright and logged in as the seeded admin. The holder is a user the admin created through `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user`, because self-registration is closed on the showcase.

**Precondition: no catalog row.** The platform set `viewer_readonly` is served by the registry (`GET /api/v1/meta/permission/viewer_readonly` answers the item). Its `sys_permission_set` row was deleted from the fresh SQLite file. The data door's `DELETE` answered `200` with `success: false` and left the row in place, so the row was deleted directly in the database. On this pre-6b-2 server the platform re-created that row once, when the holder user was created: the new row's `created_at` matches that request. So the script deletes the row at the moment of each click. It reads the row count back: `0` at the click and `0` after the add.

| Leg | Code | Requests on `sys_permission_set` / `sys_user_permission_set` | UI | Holder's `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Control | base `0665c3be7` file swapped in, then restored | `GET sys_permission_set` (name filter) answers no row; **no POST** | alert: "This set has no catalog row yet, and the server does not accept a grant by name alone yet." | unchanged: `showcase_member_default`, `member_default` |
| Add | this branch | **no** `sys_permission_set` read; `POST sys_user_permission_set` **201**, request `{"user_id":"…","permission_set":"viewer_readonly"}`; the stored grant reads `permission_set_id: null`, `organization_id` set to the caller's organization | Holly Holder listed, badge `direct` | gains `viewer_readonly` |
| Unknown name | this branch, on `…/metadata/permission/no_such_set_7611?scope=environment` (the editor opens it create-only and still shows Assigned users) | `POST` **400** `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields[0]` `permission_set` / `reference_not_found` | alert shows the server's message verbatim: "Permission Set: no permission set is named 'no_such_set_7611'. sys_user_permission_set.permission_set takes the machine name ..." | n/a |
| Revoke | this branch | `DELETE sys_user_permission_set/ID` **200** `success: true` | list empties | loses `viewer_readonly` |

The control leg's file swap was undone with `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path. The restore was proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and by the blob hash equal to HEAD's (`00f7e7c921e2`). The servers were stopped by PID afterwards, and the `--fresh` directory was removed with them.

## Tests (head `45e2c0c4d`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2` (the whole package, under the shared verify lock): `Test Files 1271 passed | 1 skipped (1272)`, `Tests 12325 passed | 9 skipped (12334)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all three touched files.
- **Three new pins** in `AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx`, on a fixture with no `sys_permission_set` row: ADD writes exactly `{ user_id, permission_set }` and reads no catalog row; a `400 reference_not_found`, built as the client builds it and passed through the adapter's own `normaliseClientError`, is shown in the server's words; REMOVE deletes the direct grant by its row id. The picker double became a one-button stand-in that makes the real dialog's `onSelectRecords` hand-off.
- **One-time ablations**, each through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit once, the blob must change, then a restore proven by `git diff HEAD` being empty and the blob being equal to HEAD's) with the shell's own `trap` restore. In each run exactly the targeted pin went red and the other 7 tests stayed green:
  - plant `permission_set_id: 'ps_legacy'` in the create body: pin 1 red at `toHaveBeenCalledWith`;
  - plant a `sys_permission_set` find before the loop: pin 1 red at `not.toContain('sys_permission_set')`;
  - `setError(cleaned || c.addFailed)` changed to `setError(c.addFailed)`: pin 2 red ("Failed to assign. Please try again." received);
  - `removeUser(r.grantId!)` changed to `removeUser(r.userId)`: pin 3 red at `toHaveBeenCalledWith`.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` was run on the three touched files: 3 files, 0 errors. The population comes from the config itself: `eslint --print-config` on the source file answers 118 rules, with no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`. So type-aware linting is off. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Gates**, all exit 0 on this head: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, and `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The part-1 changeset edit is a bounded in-place change.** All four conditions hold:
  1. It is the same card and the same defect: the sentence describes item 5's id write.
  2. It is mechanical: one sentence deleted.
  3. No open PR touches that file: #12153 and #12152 do not list it, and both have landed.
  4. It is the same gate family: the changeset gates above.
  - If a release consumes that file before this lands, the edit conflicts, and the sentence was true for that release.
- **A comment this PR makes false, in a file it may not touch.** `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`'s `cloneToCustomize` says "`AssignedUsersSection` resolves the same set's record the same way". After this PR it does not. The carrier is PR-4 (census item 4), which replaces that row read with the server clone door. It is noted here and not filed.
- **Add user is offered on a set that is not saved yet.** The editor opens an unknown name create-only, and Assigned users still shows Add user there. The add can only be refused: the server's 400 says to declare the set first. This was measured above and predates this PR: the base refused it with the `noGrantRow` text instead. The gate is `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s `showAssignments`, which is outside this PR. It is reported to the seat.
- **Server floor (not re-measured here).** A server from before objectstack#22863 requires `permission_set_id`, so there the add is refused with `400` and the section shows that refusal. The basis is the 400 that the removed module doc recorded on the earlier objectstack `main`. The changeset says so.
- Generic `RelatedList` tests in `plugin-detail` still use `permission_set_id` as a fixture column name. They test the related-list engine, not a grant writer, and are left alone (census row 8c territory).

## Not in this PR

- No change to `CapabilityMultiSelectField`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `decisionOutputParams.ts` or the clone dispatch.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` and nothing in objectstack.
